facts.business: EP Biocomposites Limited manufactures and supplies Fibre Reinforced Polymer (FRP) products such as door shutters, frames, laminated doors, biodigester tanks, bio toilets, fire-rated doors, and provides sewage & effluent treatment plants (STP/ETP) through its Aqua division for construction and industrial applications.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Planned manufacturing capacity of 2.0 lakh sq. ft.

key_risks: Dependence on government and institutional customers (40% revenue from government)
Execution risk in EPC projects for STP/ETP
Technology adoption risk for new wastewater treatment solutions
Raw material price volatility for FRP/composite products
Regulatory changes in pollution control norms
facts.related_party_note: Business takeover agreement with promoter M/s OM Ventures (sole proprietorship) dated August 31, 2021; part of EP Kamat Group
